description: This file defines a template class 'ContainerProducerRegistrationType' used for registering and revoking container producers within a process container framework. It includes mechanisms to prevent copying and moving of instances, and interacts with 'ContainerAdministrator' to announce and revoke container producers based on a specified container type.

classes.name: ContainerProducerRegistrationType
classes.description: A template class that manages registration and deregistration of a container producer for a specific container type within the process container framework.
